skill_name: Visit a website and generate a summary of the main ideas in the article.
workflow: Amid protests for police reform across the United States, attention has shifted to the little-known aspects of police power such as police contracts. These contracts are created by union negotiations between police management and local governments, and dictate the terms of work, pay, and discipline. Police unions argue that such contracts ensure justice for officers and prevent favoritism or discrimination.
